audit.whatIsWrong: Five chart rows inverted the content layer: Level 1 was credited to Lillia when the text says 'Riven owns level 1', and Levels 3, 4-5 and First item were credited to Riven when the text says the lane flips at 3 and the first item is 'the takeover'. 2+ items read Riven when the text only calls it a caveat.
audit.why: Riven's whole kill window is levels 1-2, when Lillia has one ability and no kite chain. From level 3 Swirlseed's slow plus stacking Move Speed keeps her outside Ki Burst's 260 range, and Broken Wings' three casts are all 275 range — she has to close every time, which feeds the DoT.
audit.corrected: Chart set to Riven / Skill / Lillia / Lillia / Lillia / Lillia / Skill with ratings 3, 4, 7, 7, 7, 7, 5 as matched full+content pairs.

audit.whatIsWrong: The early-game paragraph describes 'three Q dashes into an AOE knockup-stun', merging two separate abilities, and the packet notes no Riven ability is ever named in the full layer.
audit.why: Broken Wings' third cast knocks back; the stun is Ki Burst (W), 260 range on 11/10/9/8/7s. They are different buttons on different cooldowns, and the whole matchup is about baiting the 260-range one specifically. Valor (E) is the shield-dash at 250 range on 10/9/8/7/6s and is the only thing that soaks Lillia's W — which the mid text already says correctly.
audit.corrected: Early paragraph split into the knockback and the stun; real names and the 260 range written into the chart whys.
sources: brief enemyKit Q/W/E text and ranges

audit.whatIsWrong: TRICKY at 7/10 with a 7.5/10 carry threat, against a 62.5% win rate and a chart Lillia owns from level 3 to first item.
audit.why: The danger is real but confined to levels 1-2 and to a fed Riven catching her with move speed down. That is a mid-difficulty lane, not a 7/10.

edits.before: Riven's level 1-2 is the one window she owns outright — she has three Q dashes into an AOE knockup-stun and an E shield-dash, and I have a single Q and no kite chain yet, so I do not contest the wave. I farm Blooming Blows (Q) from max range and refuse to stand where her third Q can knock me up. The moment I hit 3 it flips: my Swirlseed (E) slow plus the stacking move speed from Q sweetspots means her dashes start whiffing, and the Dream Dust passive burns her down while she chases air. Never get greedy on a CS that puts me inside her W stun range before then.

I farm Blooming Blows (Q) from max range and refuse to stand where her third Q can knock me back. The moment I hit 3 it flips: my Swirlseed (E) slow plus the stacking move speed from Q sweetspots means her dashes start whiffing, and the Dream Dust passive burns her down while she chases air.
